# keboola-management_backend_snowflake_activate (Resource)

Activates a Snowflake storage backend after the Snowflake user has been configured with the public key. Only Create is supported.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `backend_id` (String) ID of the Snowflake backend to activate.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as backend_id.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the backend is enabled after activation.
